paragraphs: Software Engineer building web, mobile, and backend systems in TypeScript, Python, and Go.

On the front I work with React, React Native, and Next.js; behind them I write services in Node.js, FastAPI, and Go, backed by PostgreSQL and MongoDB. I care about architecture, real-time experiences, authentication and security, testing, accessibility, and performance — and about shipping: Docker, CI/CD, and cloud deployment are part of the job, not an afterthought.

I also have commercial experience integrating AI providers into production applications, including user-facing AI workflows, API integration, error handling, and reliability concerns. Further implementation details are confidential under NDA; Clinical Cases below is a public example of how I approach it.
features: A full-stack clinical-case trainer: an author turns free clinical text into a structured case with Gemini-assisted extraction, a learner answers, and grading is deterministic.
FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2, Alembic, and PostgreSQL 17 behind Next.js 16 Server Components
Gemini structured output validated with Pydantic; grading is exact-match against a human-supplied reference, never an LLM judgment call
TypeScript types generated from the OpenAPI contract, with CI failing on drift
pytest, mypy, Vitest, Playwright, and pixel-diff screenshot regression
